title: Debiased Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Amortized Bayesian Semi-Parametric Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.28314v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have recently gained popularity as an end-to-end approach to amortized Bayesian inference. Yet, their statistical behavior for semi-parametric targets, such as means under missingness or causal effects, remains poorly understood. In this work, we develop theoretical foundations for debiased PFNs to perform inference on finite-dimensional targets in general semi-parametric settings. First, we show that, despite being Bayes-optimal with respect to the target, an idealized PFN can exhibit a posterior concentration rate that implicitly depends on the concentration rates of (latent) nuisance functions and can become slower as the prior becomes more diverse. Then, to speed up the target posterior concentration rates, we introduce two generic debiasing strategies based on efficient influence functions: (i) a label correction and (ii) a prior correction. translated_title: 用于摊销贝叶斯半参数推断的去偏先验数据拟合网络
translated_abstract: 先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）作为端到端的摊销贝叶斯推断方法，近年来广受欢迎。然而，它们针对半参数目标（如缺失数据下的均值或因果效应）的统计行为仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们为去偏PFN建立了理论基础，使其能在一般半参数设置下对有限维目标进行推断。首先，我们证明，尽管理想的PFN相对于目标是贝叶斯最优的，其后验集中速率可能隐式依赖于（潜在）干扰函数的集中速率，并且随着先验变得更加多样化而变慢。随后，为了加快目标后验集中速率，我们基于有效影响函数提出了两种通用的去偏策略：(i) 标签校正和 先验校正。最后，我们证明去偏PFN 具备……
tldr: 该论文为去偏先验数据拟合网络建立了理论基础，揭示了理想PFN的后验集中速率会隐式依赖干扰函数并随先验多样化而变慢，并基于有效影响函数提出标签校正与先验校正两种去偏策略以加速目标后验的集中速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes theoretical foundations for debiased PFNs, showing that ideal PFNs' posterior concentration rates implicitly depend on nuisance function rates and can slow as priors diversify, and introduces two efficient influence function-based debiasing strategies—label correction and prior correction—to accelerate target posterior concentration.
